D: Ace Ventura travels to Africa to find a sacred white bat and stop a war between two tribes.
P: Serve the mains when Ace lands in Africa.
S: Crisp pastry triangles filled with spiced potato and peas, a safari camp snack. Mix 400g mashed potato with 100g peas, 2 tsp curry powder and coriander.
Toasted rice crackers with sesame and honey, the quiet start to the film. Spread 200g rice crackers on a tray, brush with honey, sprinkle with sesame and bake at 180C for 5 minutes.
M: Grilled chicken thighs in a chilli lemon marinade, with flatbread and a tomato and onion salad.
W: Little coconut and cardamom doughnuts dusted with sugar. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml coconut milk into a dough.
K: Passionfruit pulp with lime and soda over ice.

s.how: Mix 400g mashed potato with 100g peas, 2 tsp curry powder and coriander. Fill 16 spring roll wrapper triangles and fry at 180C until golden.
Spread 200g rice crackers on a tray, brush with honey, sprinkle with sesame and bake at 180C for 5 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, garlic, chilli and oil for 1 hour and grill. Serve with 4 flatbreads and a salad of 3 tomatoes, 1 red onion and coriander.

w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml coconut milk into a dough. Cut into triangles and fry at 175C until golden. Dust with sugar.

d.how: Spoon the pulp of 6 passionfruit into a jug with the juice of 2 limes and 3 tbsp sugar. Top with 1L soda water and serve over ice.
